text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus entered the academy's 
track-and-field meet. Among the 
competitors was Hishi Amazon, an 
overwhelmingly powerful racer who had 
already won graded stakes races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Defying expectations of a landslide 
victory for Hishi Amazon, Biko Pegasus 
seized the win. Hishi Amazon came to 
respect her greatly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, after the race, it was discovered 
that Biko Pegasus was injured. It seemed 
running on the turf had put too much 
strain on her legs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus instead encourages her 
downcast Trainer. Facing adversity 
head-on, she resolves to keep smiling 
especially when times are tough.
